title: Completed one-step semilinear counit germ square
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum $(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside a chosen algebraic closure $\Qlb$, with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$. Let $Y_0$ be proper of finite type over $k_0$ [def-weil-proper-morphism], $Y=Y_0\times_{k_0}k$, $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, and $a_Y:Y\to s$. Put $\gamma=(c\mapsto c^q)^{-1}$, $h=\operatorname{Spec}(\gamma)$ and $g=\operatorname{id}_{Y_0}\times h$ [def-weil-frobenius-detailed]. On the derived-complete integral constructible categories [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], write $A=La_Y^*$, $R=Ra_{Y*}$, $P=Lg^*$, $Q=Lh^*$ [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom, def-weil-derived-direct-image]. Use the specified associative pullback-composition comparisons [lem-pod-integral-pullback-composition], represented on the simultaneous whole coefficient systems [lem-trf-integral-pullback-comparison-realization]. For $M\in D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_E)$, let $\varepsilon:AR\to\mathrm{id}$ be the ordinary adjunction counit [fix-prop-adjunctions], and let $\mathcal E_M=\operatorname{FrEx}_{Y,*}(M):QRM\to RPM$ be the actual strict-system mate followed by derived inverse limit of [def-weil-frobenius-square-exchange](1). For a $k$-point $x:s\to Y$ put $Z_x=Lx^*$, $x_j=g^jxh^{-j}$, and let $u_x:Z_xA\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathrm{id}$ and $b_{1,x,M}:QZ_{x_1}M\xrightarrow{\sim}Z_xPM$ be the specified comparisons for $a_Yx=\mathrm{id}_s$ and $gx=x_1h$. Define $v_x^M=Z_x(\varepsilon_M)u_x(RM)^{-1}:RM\to Z_xM$.

The $x_j$ are $k$-points and $gx_j=x_{j+1}h$. The $v_x$ form natural transformations on $D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_E)$; explicitly $Z_x(f)v_x^M=v_x^{M'}R(f)$ for every $f:M\to M'$. If $\theta:AQ\xrightarrow{\sim}PA$ is the comparison for $a_Yg=ha_Y$, then the following are identities of the specified completed derived morphisms:
$$\varepsilon_{PM}A(\mathcal E_M)=P(\varepsilon_M)\theta_{RM},$$
$$Z_x(\theta_N)u_x(QN)^{-1}=b_{1,x,AN}Q(u_{x_1}(N)^{-1})\quad(N\in D^b_c(s,\mathcal O_E)),$$
and
$$v_x^{PM}\mathcal E_M=b_{1,x,M}Q(v_{x_1}^M):QRM\longrightarrow Z_xPM.$$
The first identity also holds for the actual mate on the ordinary derived category of strict coefficient systems, before applying the specified derived-inverse-limit functor [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections, prop-weil-pbc-rlim-functoriality]; its image under that functor and the unit/counit-preserving operation comparisons [lem-fix-operation-reduction] is the displayed completed identity. The assertion concerns these specified whole-system maps, without assuming that separate finite reductions detect equality of derived morphisms. No Weil structure on $M$ is assumed.

proof.text:
By [def-weil-frobenius-detailed], $g,h$ are scheme automorphisms with $a_Yg=ha_Y$. Thus $a_Yg^j=h^ja_Y$ (also for negative $j$, by inversion), and
$$a_Yx_j=h^ja_Yxh^{-j}=\mathrm{id}_s,\qquad gx_j=g^{j+1}xh^{-j}=x_{j+1}h.$$
In particular every $x_j$ is a $k$-point; no claim that $g$ itself is a $k$-morphism is used.

proof.text:
The counit of [fix-prop-adjunctions](1) is natural. The specified composition and identity comparisons are natural by [lem-trf-integral-pullback-comparison-realization], so $u_x^{-1}$ is natural. For $f:M\to M'$ their two naturality equations give
$$Z_x(f)v_x^M=Z_x(\varepsilon_{M'})Z_xA(Rf)u_x(RM)^{-1}=Z_x(\varepsilon_{M'})u_x(RM')^{-1}R(f)=v_x^{M'}R(f).$$
This proves naturality on the stated integral constructible category.

proof.text:
First work in the ordinary derived categories of strict coefficient systems of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. In this step denote their operations and adjunction data by $A,R,P,Q,\varepsilon,\eta,\theta$. The system exchange in [def-weil-frobenius-square-exchange](1) is the mate of $\theta$. Put $T=P(\varepsilon_M)\theta_{RM}:AQRM\to PM$. By [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate], its explicit adjunction transpose is $e_M=R(T)\eta_{QRM}$. Counit naturality for $T$ and the left triangle identity give
$$\varepsilon_{PM}A(e_M)=\varepsilon_{PM}AR(T)A(\eta_{QRM})=T\varepsilon_{AQRM}A(\eta_{QRM})=T.$$
These are equations in the derived category of the whole system: the adjunction in the cited node is on that category. This proves the requested pre-limit identity.

proof.text: Return to completed notation. Apply the specified realization $\mathcal L_Y=R\varprojlim\circ U_Y$ to step 3 and use its analogue on the source scheme. Restriction $U_Y$ and the derived-limit functor [prop-weil-pbc-rlim-functoriality] preserve composition and equality. In [def-weil-frobenius-square-exchange](1), the actual integral map is defined as $\beta_*\mathcal L_Y(e_M)\alpha_*$. The operation comparisons of [lem-fix-operation-reduction] preserve units and counits. The integral comparison $\theta$ is, by [lem-trf-integral-pullback-comparison-realization], the realization of the termwise system composition isomorphisms transported by its displayed counit comparisons, so the image of the system $\theta$ is the integral $\theta$. Substitution of these specified comparison isomorphisms therefore turns the image of the left side of step 3 into $\varepsilon_{PM}A(\mathcal E_M)$ and the image of its right side into $P(\varepsilon_M)\theta_{RM}$. This proves the first displayed completed identity for the specified map, by functorial realization of one system equation.

proof.text:
Write $a=a_Y$ and $c_{r,t}:L(tr)^*\to Lr^*Lt^*$ for the specified family of [lem-trf-integral-pullback-comparison-realization]. That node supplies associativity, unit comparisons and compatibility with equality of scheme maps, on whole diagrams before realization. Suppressing only these identity-pullback unitors,
$$u_x^{-1}=c_{x,a},\quad \theta=c_{g,a}c_{a,h}^{-1},\quad b_{1,x}=c_{x,g}c_{h,x_1}^{-1}.$$
Associativity for $(x,a,h)$ with $ax=\mathrm{id}$ gives
$$Z_x(c_{a,h}^{-1})u_x(QN)^{-1}=c_{x,ha}(N).$$
Associativity for $(h,x_1,a)$ with $ax_1=\mathrm{id}$ gives
$$Q(u_{x_1}(N)^{-1})=c_{h,x_1}(AN)c_{x_1h,a}(N).$$
Now $ha=ag$ and $x_1h=gx$. Using associativity for $(x,g,a)$, both $Z_x(\theta_N)u_x(QN)^{-1}$ and $b_{1,x,AN}Q(u_{x_1}(N)^{-1})$ become $c_{x,g}(AN)c_{gx,a}(N)$. This proves the second displayed identity with exactly the specified comparisons, including their whole-system normalization.

proof.text:
Use naturality of $u_x^{-1}$ for $\mathcal E_M:QRM\to RPM$, then steps 4 and 5 at $N=RM$, and finally naturality of the specified comparison $b_{1,x}$ for $\varepsilon_M:ARM\to M$ ([lem-trf-integral-pullback-comparison-realization]):
$$\begin{aligned}
v_x^{PM}\mathcal E_M
&=Z_x(\varepsilon_{PM})Z_xA(\mathcal E_M)u_x(QRM)^{-1}\\
&=Z_xP(\varepsilon_M)Z_x(\theta_{RM})u_x(QRM)^{-1}\\
&=Z_xP(\varepsilon_M)b_{1,x,ARM}Q(u_{x_1}(RM)^{-1})\\
&=b_{1,x,M}Q(Z_{x_1}(\varepsilon_M))Q(u_{x_1}(RM)^{-1})
=b_{1,x,M}Q(v_{x_1}^M).
\end{aligned}$$
Every line has source $QRM$ and target $Z_xPM$. Only functoriality, naturality and the already proved identities were used; no Weil structure or finite-reduction detection of morphism equality is needed.
